comfydlAbout.summary: ComfyDL_UI is the GUI runtime of ComfyDL: a deep-learning-tuned fork of ComfyUI that ships the tensor, layer and training nodes this project adds.
comfydlAbout.notOriginal: This is not the complete original ComfyUI: it is a dehydrated fork that keeps only what the ComfyDL node pack needs. To use the original ComfyUI instead, download it from the official repository.
